test_learn_batch: test that DisjointBanditContainer learns correct arm models from a TransitionBatch over 1000 iterations
test_ucb_act: test UCB exploration action selection returns the highest-reward arm after training on a batch
test_thompson_sampling_disjoint_act: test Thompson sampling exploration returns valid actions within the discrete action space
test_get_scores: test that get_scores returns UCB scores matching mus plus alpha times sigmas per arm
test_traced_disjoint_bandit_container: test that a TorchScript-traced DisjointBanditContainer produces identical results to the original model
